title: A failed Claude background full gate gets no failed record: the host reports "no verified completion" and records nothing
outcome: When a Claude session's full gate launched in the documented Bash background form (pushd "DIR" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full) exits nonzero, the host records a failed verification record for that run on the claim, just as it records a credited pass. It does not treat the failed background task as unverified work and withhold the run with "earned no credit ... Run the gate again".
acceptance: A failed Claude background full gate gets no failed record: the host reports "no verified completion" and records nothing is done
